summary_en: 1,100,000 shares (2.61% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 block trade on 2026-08-03 at closing price; ¥1.4B upper limit; 3,000,000 shares (7.11% of S/O) to be cancelled effective 2026-08-31. Execution window: single block trade window on 2026-08-03 at 08:45 JST.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Treasury Stock Purchase via Off-Exchange Trade (ToSTNeT-3), Determination of Terms, and Cancellation of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief: Kanro Inc. announced on 31 July 2026 that its board has resolved to acquire up to 1,100,000 treasury shares (2.61% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum total of ¥1.4 billion via a single off-exchange block trade (ToSTNeT-3) scheduled for 08:45 JST on 3 August 2026. The purchase price will be determined at the closing price on 31 July 2026 and confirmed thereafter; the maximum price per share is ¥1,272. The board has also resolved to cancel 3,000,000 treasury shares (7.11% of outstanding shares ex-treasury) effective 31 August 2026. Both actions are undertaken to return capital to shareholders and to manage capital policy flexibly in response to changing business conditions.
